annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and exact-remainder finite formalization of Theorem 4.5

assumptions: The factorization and both triangular solves satisfy the exact perturbation equations shown in the proof of Theorem 4.5.
The factorization remainder has the explicitly supplied finite upper bound factorRemainder.
The two matrix perturbations are bounded by gammaC times the Frobenius norm of their triangular factor.
The two right-hand-side perturbations are bounded by gammaP times the corresponding Euclidean vector norm, with 0 <= gammaP < 1.
The triangular-solve matrix coefficient gammaC is nonnegative.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P15 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P15 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.plain_language: The BLR LU factorization perturbation and the two BLR triangular-solve perturbations compose into the exact matrix and right-hand-side backward errors of Theorem 4.5, with all finite cross terms retained.

informal_proof: Expand (L+dL)(U+dU), use the factorization equation, and compose the two solve equations to obtain the exact perturbed system. Apply Frobenius triangle and submultiplicativity to the four matrix-error terms. For the right-hand side, bound y from (U+dU)x = y+dy, solve the finite feedback inequality using gammaP < 1, and substitute it into the two action bounds.
informal_statement: An exact finite-remainder certificate for Theorem 4.5 equations (4.23)-(4.25), retaining the coefficient products suppressed by O(u epsilon) and O(u^2).
